sources.title: Gojong Sillok 31st year 1894 lunar July 3 official received reform proposal and royal assent
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, Sillok digital received edition
sources.quality_notes: 科文取士 and 科舉之法變通後另定選舉條例, 竝允之. Assents to a general reform/ordinance process, not an explicitly named Myeonggwa exam abolition or 1874 Seontaekgiyo book-restoration order. Old calendar date is not a Gregorian date.

sources.title: Joseon early official gazette July 28 1894 office rules Gwansangguk tasks
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History, Joseon and Korean Empire Gazette DB
sources.quality_notes: 學務衙門官制改定及增補 includes 一觀象局掌天文曆數測候等事務參議一員主事六員. Office scope establishes astronomy/calendar/weather tasks; it neither cites Ziwei/Ziping books nor positively proves disappearance or continuation of all auspicious-day duties. Public DB is digitized text, original page image not inspected.

sources.title: AKS encyclopedia Gwansangso 1894/1895/1907 institutional succession
sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies encyclopedia, modern scholarly summary
sources.quality_notes: States 觀象監->觀象局 under 學務衙門 in 1894, 觀象所 under 學部 in 1895, 測候所 in 1907; dates/offices are a secondary synthesis, not a contemporaneous 1895 original statute or proof of Myeonggwa courses.

sources.title: AKS encyclopedia Myeonggwa-hak observatory subject and 1909 cessation metadata
sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies encyclopedia, 2023 authored 2024 revised entry
sources.quality_notes: Definition explains early astronomy/geomancy/Myeonggwa-hak three divisions and choosing dates/times; metadata labels abolition 1909. No reviewed contemporary abolition edict is provided here, cannot imply uninterrupted 1894-1909 technical training or confirm 1874 book reinstatement.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1894 general examination reform order does not itself prove a specific restored-or-abolished 1867 Myeonggwa textbook
1894 Gwansangguk observatory remit does not prove unbroken or abolished Ziwei/Ziping technical transmission
1909 modern encyclopedia abolition metadata cannot bridge 1894-1909 curriculum or office continuity
unresolved_lineage_questions: exact post1874 court order or examination paper reinstating pre1867 Yuan Tiangang text
the executed 1894 selection ordinance for Myeonggwa technical examination, if any
contemporaneous original 1895/1909 office and Myeonggwa department change decrees
actual teaching manuscripts and class records before/after office reorganization
